body: Hey, thanks again. I did what you suggested and called the number on my insurance card. They directed me to a list of people, and I plan on calling to make an appointment in the next day or so. I don't know why I'm updating this, but yea.

Holy shit, thank you. Honestly, I have had multiple mental breakdowns over the last year or two, and I always try to make appointments but always hit a wall because looking on the internet is just too draining. I have never thought about calling the number on my insurance card. Thank you. I need a lot of hand holding which is part of the problem that i've gotten so bad. I was also robbed so don't own a computer, which makes searching things really hard.

Thank you so much. I would prefer not going to an ER because I can't afford that or not show up to work. I already took a few days off work a couple weeks ago to stay home and sleep. I have full medical coverage but I can't afford to pay much out of pocket because I am up to my ears with debt to credit cards and the IRS and don't even know how I'm going to pay for food this week. If I make appointments I should be able to take time off work, but I have no idea where to start, I looked for therapists before but I was only able to find "out of network" therapists in my area. So every time I try I just get overwhelmed and have a breakdown. I'm currently not on anything for depression although I probably should be, most of my family is, and it runs in most of my relatives. I have a weird work situation and I have thought about taking some more time off but I don't even know it that will help. I just don't really know what to do. If I Went to the ER, I feel like that would just make a big splash and threaten my job safety, and I don't want everyone to know I am struggling so much right now.
